minor_issues.issue: 二、研究思路中'在不改变 760–860 μg/L 滴度时为何毫无效果'表述略有歧义——NYB-1A 实测 760 μg/L，相对于 4N24 的 860 μg/L 实际上是轻微下降而非'不变'。
minor_issues.source_locator: 原文 Section 3.3, p.130；草稿二、研究思路
minor_issues.correction: 建议改为'NYB-1A (760 μg/L) 与 NYB-1B (860 μg/L) 相对基础菌 860 μg/L 均无实质提升'

minor_issues.issue: Figure 5 实际还包含 NYB-6D/7 等条目，草稿中描述 NYB-6B/C 的'最高滴度'时未指出原图横轴存在全部 28 个条目（4N24 至 NYB-11）。
minor_issues.correction: 可在描述时补充'Figure 5A 横轴列出全部 28 株工程菌'

verified_claims.claim: S. albidoflavus 4N24 在 10 g/L 甘露醇基本培养基中 275 h 累积 860 μg/L 尼博霉素，20% 在生长期、80% 在稳定期。
verified_claims.evidence: Abstract:'produced 860 μg L−1 of nybomycin, mainly in the stationary phase'; Section 3.2:'S. albidoflavus 4N24 formed 860 μg L−1 nybomycin over 275 h (Fig. 3A)...20% nybomycin was produced during the growth phase, though the stationary phase was the major phase of production (80%)'

verified_claims.claim: 首轮 PermE* 驱动的 tkt/zwf2 过表达未改善产量：NYB-1A 760 μg/L，NYB-1B 860 μg/L。
verified_claims.evidence: 'a nybomycin titer of 760 μg L−1 for NYB-1A and 860 μg L−1 for NYB-1B (Fig. 5A)'

verified_claims.claim: PkasOP* 驱动的 PP/SA 通路过表达：NYB-2A 1070 μg/L、NYB-2B 1095 μg/L、NYB-2F 1160 μg/L；组合株 NYB-4B 1644 μg/L、NYB-4C 1638 μg/L。
verified_claims.evidence: 'NYB-2A (4N24 PkasOP* tkt) and NYB-2B (4N24 PkasOP* zwf2) accumulated 29% and 31% more...i.e., 1070 and 1095 μg L−1'; '1160 μg L−1 in the new strain NYB-2F'; 'strains NYB-4B (1644 μg L−1) and NYB-4C (1638 μg L−1)'

verified_claims.claim: ΔnybW 解抑制：NYB-5 滴度 1418 μg/L（+70%）；NYB-8 ΔnybWX 1990 μg/L；NYB-9 ΔnybWXYZ 2530 μg/L。
verified_claims.evidence: 'strain NYB-5 produced a nybomycin titer of 1418 μg L−1, 70% more than the basic strain'; 'NYB-8 accumulated 1990 μg L−1'; 'while NYB-9 formed 2530 μg L−1'

verified_claims.claim: NYB-10 2510 μg/L、NYB-11 3570 μg/L；NYB-11 在 50 g/L 甘露醇最小培养基中达到 12 mg/L，相对 4N24 提高约 15 倍。
verified_claims.evidence: 'NYB-10 accumulated 2510 μg L−1 nybomycin, while NYB-11 accumulated 3570 μg L−1, more than fourfold more than 4N24'; 'achieving the highest final nybomycin titer of 12 mg L−1. Overall, systems metabolic engineering...enabled an almost fifteen-fold increase'

verified_claims.claim: 正调控 8 启动子（PermE*、PtipA、PSF14、P21、PkasOP*、PSP41、PSP43、PSP44）实时评估显示 PkasOP* 与 PSP41 最强且全程表达稳定期；PSP43、PSP44 约为 PermE* 三倍，PkasOP* 与 PSP41 约为 7 倍。
verified_claims.evidence: 'The two variants PSP43 and PSP44 were found to be threefold more active than PermE*...PkasOP* and its synthetic derivative PSP41 were the two best promotors, exhibiting the highest overall activity (sevenfold higher than PermE*)'

verified_claims.claim: 转录组：4N24 中 2044/5790 基因（35.3%）在生长期（13 h）与生产期（70 h）间显著差异（log2FC ≥1, p ≤ 0.05）；nyb 簇在生产期整体下调 log2FC 至 −3.4，唯 nybV/X/Y/Z 维持上调；GEO 登录号 GSE240471；基因组登录 CP113229。
verified_claims.evidence: 'Expression of 2044 of 5790 encoded genes (35.3%) significantly differed...log2-fold change ≥1, p ≤ 0.05'; 'almost all cluster genes showed reduced expression (log2-fold changes up to −3.4), except for nybV...nybX, nybZ, and nybY'; 'available from GEO (GSE240471)'; 'Accession no. CP113229'

verified_claims.claim: orf-02 与假定转座酶（A0A2T0GVF8）50% 同源，含 PF13546 内切酶结构域，被重新定义为最小 nyb 簇新左侧边界；nybT/nybU 双缺失彻底失产，单缺失互补。
verified_claims.evidence: 'BLAST analysis...revealed 50% similarity to a putative transposase (A0A2T0GVF8)...presence of an endonuclease domain (Pfam: PF13546)...orf-02 displays the new left boundary'; 'a double-deletion mutant lacking both nybT and nybU no longer produced nybomycin'

verified_claims.claim: NYB-3A（PkasOP* nybM）滴度 300 μg/L；NYB-3B（PkasOP* nybV）弱生长且低产；NYB-7（ΔnybW PkasOP* nybF tkt zwf2）滴度 70 μg/L；NYB-6B 在最优条件下（DNP/Mtl50）达 7.2 mg/L。
verified_claims.evidence: 'NYB-3A...produced only 300 μg L−1'; 'NYB-3B...showed weak growth...and low nybomycin production'; 'Nybomycin production in this strain, however, was almost eliminated (70 μg L−1)'; 'a final nybomycin titer of 7.2 mg L−1 (7185 μg L−1)'
